name: AG-UI
tagline: An event-based protocol and SDKs for communication between agents and user interfaces.
hook: Defines which state survives sequential runs in one event stream and which per-run tracking must reset.
summary: AG-UI's CLAUDE.md describes typed protocol events, streaming abstractions, and the framework integration pattern. It also routes A2UI rendering work to a dedicated skill and separates TypeScript and Python development commands.

techniques.title: Route a specific integration task to its skill
techniques.body: The file opens with a trigger for adding A2UI rendering or scaffolding a combined quickstart. It gives the exact skill path rather than leaving the agent to search a large integration repository.
techniques.quote:
For requests to add A2UI rendering to AG-UI applications or to scaffold an
AG-UI + A2UI quickstart, use `skills/ag-ui-a2ui-integration/SKILL.md`.

techniques.title: Define the boundary between sequential runs
techniques.body: The protocol section requires one run to finish before another begins. It separately records that messages accumulate while active-message, tool-call, and step tracking reset.
techniques.quote: - Each run must complete (RUN_FINISHED) before a new run can start (RUN_STARTED)

techniques.title: Distinguish evolving state from a reset
techniques.body: State management names full snapshots and JSON Patch deltas. The sequential-run section clarifies that starting another run does not itself discard the state.
techniques.quote: - State continues to evolve across runs unless explicitly reset with STATE_SNAPSHOT

techniques.title: Name the adapter contract for new integrations
techniques.body: The architecture section identifies AbstractAgent and its streaming return type. The integration checklist then describes translating framework events into protocol events and providing runnable examples.
techniques.quote: **AbstractAgent**: Base class that all agents must implement with a `run(input: RunAgentInput) -> Observable<BaseEvent>` method

steal: Give named integration tasks an exact skill entry point.
Document lifecycle boundaries in long-lived event streams.
State what persists and what resets between operations.
Show the typed contract every adapter must implement.
outline: General Guidelines for working with Nx
